mn: A single horizontal stroke: hold up one finger sideways.
Two stacked lines, one short and one long: two.
Three stacked lines: count them, three.
A box with four walls; picture a room split by two legs inside.
Between a top and bottom line sits a zigzag like a hand's five fingers squeezed flat.
A little hat (亠) over two splayed legs: a stick figure doing the six-count dance.
Looks like an upside-down 7 with a line through it.
Two strokes splitting apart like the number 8 cut down the middle.
Looks like a hooked 9 kicking out a leg: nine.
A cross, like the plus sign; count your ten fingers crossed.
One (一) on top of white (白): one blank white page holds a hundred words.
Ten (十) with a slash on top: ten, then a flourish to multiply to a thousand.
A line with a hooked leg and a slash: a big 'm' for 'many': ten thousand.
A frame like a cash register drawer with a divider inside: where the yen goes.
A window with one bar across: the sun shining through it by day.
A tall crescent moon with two cloud lines across it.
A campfire: a central flame with two sparks flying off each side.
A central stream with splashes flicking off both sides.
A tree: a trunk, a branch across, and roots spreading down.
A roof over the earth (土) with two nuggets: gold buried in the ground.
A sprout (十) pushing up from the ground line: soil.
Sun (日) on the left, wings (羽) over a bird (隹) on the right: the sun rises on a new bird each day of the week.
A person with a hoe bent over grain: one harvest marks one year.
Sun (日) beside a temple (寺): the temple bell tells the time by the sun.
Eight (八, split apart) over a sword (刀): cut something into parts.
A vertical line slices straight down the middle of the shape: half.
Like 牛 (cow) without the horn poking out the top: at noon the cow lies still in the heat.
Horns on top, a moon/meat (月) and a knife (刂): the butcher stands in front of the counter.
Going (彳) with a thread (幺) and dragging feet (夂): the slow one trails behind.
A roof (人) over a single line and a hook: under the roof, right now.
A person on top of mother (母, slightly altered): every mother, every day.
Going around (周) on the road (辶): a week is one trip around the calendar.
Sun (日) seen between the two doors of a gate (門): the space between.
A line points up from the ground line: above.
A line hangs down from the top line: below.
A hand (ナ) holding a carpenter's tool (工): the left hand steadies the tool.
A hand (ナ) lifting food to the mouth (口): most people eat with the right hand.
A line pierces straight through the middle of a box.
Evening (夕) plus a divination crack (卜): fortune-tellers worked outside at dusk.
The sun (日) rising behind a tree (木): east.
A box with a lid and two legs inside: a saloon door in the Wild West.
Ten (十) on top of a warm hut holding a ¥-shaped stove: the warm south.
Two people sitting back to back, turning away from the cold north wind.
Three peaks, the middle one tallest: a mountain.
Three lines of water flowing downstream.
A field seen from above, divided into four paddies.
A big person (大) with one more line above the head: the sky above everyone.
Steam (气) rising with an X of energy inside: invisible spirit in the air.
A sky with a roof of cloud and four drops falling inside the window.
Grass (艹) over change (化): a plant changing into a flower.
A hole (穴) over work (工): look up from the work pit and see the empty sky.
A head on top, a scaly body (田) in the middle, and a tail fin (four dots) at the bottom.
Two legs walking: a person.
A baby wrapped in a blanket with its arms out.
A figure kneeling gracefully with crossed arms.
Rice field (田) over power (力): the one who uses his strength in the field.
Two crossed sticks under two strokes: dad waving his tools around.
A kneeling woman shape with two dots inside: mother nursing.
Two hands (ナ and 又) reaching toward each other: friends shaking hands.
A cow-like top (⺧) over human legs (儿): walking ahead of the herd.
A sprout growing up out of the earth (土): new life.
A child (子) under a roof with light shining on it (⺍): a child learning at school.
Tree (木) beside mix (交): kids mixing together under the trees of the schoolyard.
Evening (夕) plus mouth (口): in the dark you must call out your name.
A tree (木) with a mark at its base: the root, the origin; books are made from trees.
Words (言) plus I/me (吾): the words I speak make my language.
A jewel (玉) protected inside borders (囗): a country guards its treasure.
An open square mouth.
An eye turned on its side, with the pupil lines inside.
An ear shape with folds inside, like an earlobe drawn tall.
A palm with fingers spread and a bent wrist below.
A knee cap (口) on top of a leg and foot.
A flexed arm showing its muscle.
A person (亻) leaning against a tree (木): taking a rest.
Words (lines) coming out over a mouth (口).
Words (言) plus a tongue (舌): talking.
Words (言) being sold (売): the merchant reads out his goods.
A hand holding a brush (聿) above a sun (日): writing in the daylight.
A big eye (目) on walking legs (儿): an eye going around looking.
An ear (耳) pressed to the gate (門): listening in.
A roof (人) over something good (良): a good meal under a roof.
Food (飠) plus a yawning mouth (欠): gulping a drink down.
A crossroads (彳 and 亍) where people go in every direction.
Like a tree (木) with an extra line and two dots: fruit coming on the branches.
Two mountains (山) stacked: climb over the mountains to get out.
Like 人 but leaning the other way: a person ducking to enter.
A person with arms out standing firmly on the ground line.
A net (罒) over a shell/money (貝): scooping up goods with money.
A roof (人) over two (二) and a nose-like shape (ム): people meeting under one roof.
An altar (礻) on the earth (土): a shrine, where people gather like a company.
Rain (雨) over a field with a lightning tail (电): electricity from the storm.
A cart seen from above: an axle through a box with wheels top and bottom.
A horse (馬) on the left: where horses used to be changed, now trains.
A head (首) on the move (辶): follow your head down the road.
A lean-to roof (广) over a fortune-teller's stall (占): a small shop.
An old man with long flowing hair: the long-haired chief.
A tall tower with a roof, a window (口), and another mouth-shaped door: a high building.
A woman (女) safe under a roof (宀): peace.
Stand (立) over a tree (木) next to an axe (斤): freshly cut new wood.
Ten (十) mouths (口) retelling a story: it must be old.
A person stretching out arms and legs as wide as possible: big.
A small hook with a drop on each side: something tiny split in two.
The sun (日) with a ray of light on top: bright white.
Two evenings (夕) stacked: many nights have passed.
Small (小) with one more stroke slicing off: even less.
A person (亻) next to 可 (possible): a person asking 'what is possible?'
Three lines of sprouting plants over a person (人) and the sun (日): spring sunshine.
A head (頁-like top) over dragging feet (夂): too hot to walk fast in summer.
Grain (禾) beside fire (火): burning the fields after the autumn harvest.
Dragging feet (夂) over two drops of ice (冫): shuffling through winter.
The sun (日) rising between grass (十 above and below) while the moon (月) is still out: morning.
A body (尺) lying over the sun (日) on the ground line: a nap in the midday sun.
A crescent moon just appearing: evening.
A lid (亠) over a person (亻) and an evening moon (夕-like shape): a person tucked in at night.
The sun (日) over ten (十): the sun up by ten is early.
A person bent over a kneeling figure (巴): a blushing face changes color.
Earth (土) over a fire-like base: glowing red soil.
New growth (龶, like 生) over the moon (月): blue-green sprouts under a pale moon.
A field (田) over earth (土) above fire (灬): soot from a burning field turns it black.
Grass (艹) over a person (人) and a tree (木): someone sipping leaf tea under a tree.
Water (氵) and every (毎): every drop of water ends up in the sea.
Water (氵) plus 也 (a coiled shape): a pond with a snake coiled beside it.
A sail-like frame (几) with a bug (虫) blown inside: the wind carries insects.
Rays shooting out above human legs (儿): a person carrying a torch.
Earth (土) plus 也 (a coiled snake): the ground where snakes live.
Three trees (木): more than a grove, a forest.
Two trees (木) side by side: a small grove.
A cow's head seen from the front, with one horn sticking up.
Big (大) with a dot: a dog is a big animal with a dot of a nose.
A bird with an eye at the top, a body, and tail feathers (灬) as its feet.
A pig (豕) under a roof (宀): in the old days, a house held the family and its pig.
A big mouth (口) on legs (儿): the older brother always talking and bossing.
Horns (丷) on a coiled bow (弓) shape: the younger brother tied up in his big brother's games.
A woman (女) who runs the city (市): big sister is in charge.
A woman (女) who is not yet (未) grown: little sister.
Standing (立) on a tree (木) to see (見): parents climb up to watch for their children.
A king (王) with a dot like a flame on top: the master of the house tends the lamp.
Grain (禾) plus 'mine' (ム): my own private rice.
A nose (the old drawing of 自): Japanese point to their nose to say 'me'.
An old-person top (耂) over the sun (日): a person who has worked under many suns.
A mouth (口) over a shell/money (貝): a member is a mouth that gets paid.
An arrow (矢) inside a box (匚): the doctor locks away the arrow that wounded you.
A flag (方 + ⺃) over an arrow (矢): a clan gathered under its banner with its arrows.
A person (亻) plus a root/base (本): the body is a person's base.
A bean (豆) next to a head (頁): a bean-shaped head.
A handsome forehead (彦) next to a head (頁): the face.
Two hairs (丷) on top of a nose (自): the head sitting on your neck.
A heart with three beats (dots) and a curved chamber.
The sickbed radical (疒) holding third place (丙): too ill to finish first.
A bone (歹) next to a fallen person (匕): death.
Rice fields (田) with a nail-straight street (丁): a town.
Trees (木) and a hand measuring (寸): a village marked out among the trees.
A lid (亠) over a hanging cloth (巾): a market stall's awning.
An eye (目) over a hanging line (like 小): the governor watches over the prefecture from above.
An X inside a three-sided box (匚): a marked-off district.
A lid (亠) over a mouth (口) and small (小): a tall gatehouse of the capital.
A person (者) next to a village (阝, right side): where all the people gather, the capital.
A door (戸) plus an axe (斤): the place where the woodcutter lives.
Earth (土) where the sun (日) shines: an open place.
A field (田) with a boundary (介) between: the world divided into fields.
Three tens (十) joined: thirty years, one generation.
A body under a roof (尸) arriving (至): everyone reaches the shop.
A roof (宀) over arriving (至): the room you arrive in.
Food (飠) next to an official (官): a large hall where officials dine.
A fine roof (⺌ over 冖 and 口) on earth (土): a grand hall.
A hill (阝, left side) with a finished (完) building: an institution on the hill.
A frame (囗) around lines and dots: a map drawn in a box.
An I-beam or carpenter's square: a tool for building.
Metal (金) plus 艮: a metal that shines: silver.
Two swinging doors: a gate.
Rice (米) measured with a ladle (斗): ingredients and their fee.
A king (王, jewel radical) in a village (里): a well-ordered village runs on reason.
Food (飠) plus 'return' (反): you keep returning to rice at every meal.
A frame with two 人 inside: marbled meat on the butcher's hook.
A mouth (口) plus 'not yet' (未): taste it before it's gone.
Water (氵) plus sheep (羊): white waves like sheep across the ocean.
A cow (牛) plus 勿: livestock was a family's most valuable thing.
Three boxes (口) stacked: goods piled up in a store.
An old man (耂) and a child (子) next to a hand with a stick (攵): teaching.
Wings (羽) over white (白): a white chick flapping its wings again and again, learning to fly.
免 (escape) plus power (力): studying takes effort you can't escape.
A bow (弓) beside ム over a bug (虫): a bug strong enough to pull a bow.
A child (子) under a roof (宀): a child at home practicing letters.
A lid (亠) over crossed strokes (乂): a pattern of writing.
Water (氵) beside a grassy shape: the Han river of China.
Grass (艹) over center (央): the flower at the center, brilliant.
A stone (石) with a flat shape (开): polishing stones, like refining research.
A hole (穴) with nine (九): digging nine holes to investigate thoroughly.
Words (言) plus ceremony (式): a formal test.
A horse (馬) to test: try out the horse before buying it.
A mouth (口) at the gate (門): someone at the door asking a question.
Is/right (是) next to a head (頁): the heading at the top of the page.
Bamboo (竹) over fit (合): a bamboo slip that fits the question.
Two axes (斤斤) over a shell/money (貝): weighing the quality of the money.
Words (言) plus a brother figure (兑): big brother explains it with words.
A sound (音) over the heart (心): the meaning behind what the heart says.
An arrow (矢) plus a mouth (口): knowledge shoots from the mouth like an arrow.
An old person (耂) with a bent cane: old folks sit and think.
A field (田) over the heart (心): your heart and mind full of thoughts.
Words (言) plus ten (十): counting to ten out loud.
A field (田) inside a frame (凵) under a line: a picture in its frame.
The sun (日) at the center (央): light projected onto the screen.
A cover (冖) over a 与 shape: a photographer under the camera cloth.
Stand (立) over the sun (日): the morning sound when you stand up at sunrise.
White (白) between strings on a wooden (木) stand: a musical instrument is fun.
Two 可 stacked next to a yawning mouth (欠): open wide and sing.
Stop (止) over a few (少-like) steps: walking is stopping and stepping.
Earth (土) over a running foot (止-like base): feet pounding the ground.
Run (走) plus self (己): you yourself run out of bed.
A footprint planted firmly: stop.
Heavy (重) plus power (力): it takes strength to move something heavy.
A person (亻) who moves (動): a person in motion is working.
A person (亻) next to an official (吏): officials use people.
A person (亻) at work with a saw-like tool (乍): making things.
A hand (扌) plus a temple (寺): monks hold on to the temple.
Going (彳) to the temple (寺): waiting in line at the temple.
A road (辶) with a package tied up on top: sending it off.
The road (辶) with a hollow tube (甬): pass straight through.
A military vehicle (軍) on the road (辶): carrying supplies.
A car (車) plus 云: the wheels turn round and round.
A person riding high on top of a tree (木 at the base) with arms spread.
Hands lifting the bar (开) of a gate (門): opening it.
A sword-like stroke (刂-like) beside a broom and cloth (帚): coming home to clean up.
A sheep (⺷) over an eye (目): the sheep's wool you put on and wear.
A person (亻) plus 'long ago' (昔): borrowing from someone long ago and never returning it.
Replace (代) over money (貝): lending money that must be replaced.
A samurai (士) over a covered table (冖) with legs (儿): a seller at his stall.
A woman (女) plus 台 (platform): life begins with a woman.
Thread (糸) plus winter (冬): the thread of the year ends in winter.
Seven (七) plus a sword (刀): cut it into seven pieces.
A bow (弓) with a string line (丨): pull back the bowstring.
A bird (隹) on a tree (木): birds gather in the tree.
A person (亻) and a master (主): the master lives in the house.
Legs spread (癶) over a launcher (like 开 with legs): launching off.
A bent figure and a hand (⺕) over the heart (心): heart racing in a hurry.
Earth (土) over ム: someone walking away across the ground.
Water (氵) plus master (主): the master pours water carefully.
A brush (聿) on a long stride (廴): drafting the plans and building.
Water (氵) plus first (先): first, wash with water.
Sun (日) and moon (月) together: very bright.
Sun (日) plus sound (音): when the sun goes down you only hear sounds in the dark.
Sun (日) over a person (者): a person baking under the sun.
A roof (宀) over bundled blankets and two ice drops (冫): cold even indoors.
A cart loaded full of earth (里 with a lid): heavy.
A car (車) plus 圣: a light cart that rolls easily.
An axe (斤) on the road (辶): the woodcutter is near.
A long robe (袁) on the road (辶): dressed for a long, far journey.
A roof (广) over ム: a big open shed with lots of space.
Two bows (弓) with feathers: bows too weak to shoot alone.
Second-rate (亜) over the heart (心): a second-rate heart is bad.
A person (亻) plus 氐 (bottom): a person at the bottom, low.
Big (大) with an extra dot: bigger than big, fat.
An arrow (矢) next to a bean (豆): both are short.
A woman (女) holding a child (子): she likes her child.
One (一) over stop (止): stop at the line, that's correct.
A frame (冂) with one (一) and a mouth (口) inside: everyone speaking with one mouth, the same.
A cow (牛) at the temple (寺): a special sacred cow.
A person (亻) plus 更 (renew): a person who renews things makes life convenient.
A line blocking a bird flying up: it can not go.
Two (二) over human legs (儿): the first person, the origin.
Ten (十) over an eye (目) on a stand: ten eyes checking that it's true.
A hand (ナ) holding meat (月): to have something.
A lid (亠) over a bent arm pointing: which direction?
A hand holding a stick with a flag through a mouth (口): taking care of things.
A person (亻) plus a samurai (士): a samurai serves his lord.
A person (亻) plus a stake (弋): one person takes the other's place.
A person (人) next to a plough shape: by means of the tool.
A building (广) with 廿 and a hand (又): measuring by hand-spans, degree by degree.
A mouth (口) over a bent force (力-like) and a knife (刂): cut off and separated.
A small box spinning inside a big box: turning around.
Moon/body (月) plus a kneeling person held by a hand (𠬝): dressing the body.
Thread (糸) plus clan (氏): paper made from fibers.
ム over a mouth (口): a nose above a mouth, like a podium where you speak.
A fence or bucket with a handle: something useful.
A samurai (士) over a door (戸-like): a samurai's voice booming through the door.
A direction (方) plus a flag and people: travelers following a banner.
A lid (人) fitting over a box (一 over 口): it fits perfectly.
Eight (八) over ム (private): split up the private, make it public.
